definitions.explanation: The color pink. Can be used as a noun or as a na-adjective (ピンクな/ピンクの).
Informal usage referring to adult or sexual content.

examples.japanese: ピンクの{花|はな}がきれいに{咲|さ}いています。
examples.english: The pink flowers are blooming beautifully.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はピンクが{大好|だいす}きです。
ピンク{色|いろ}のドレスを{買|か}いました。

notes: A loanword from English. When used with nouns, ピンクの is more common than ピンクな. The slang sense (erotic) appears in words like ピンク{映画|えいが} (adult film) and ピンクサロン.
